headline: Accenture: Only 46% of Young Members Trust Their Payer
summary: Accenture's survey found only 46% of Gen Z and Millennial health plan members trust their health plans, a data point Accenture is using to anchor a payer digital transformation advisory conversation. The finding is real: prior auth friction, algorithmic denial coverage, and CEO-level media scandals have genuinely damaged younger member trust. The watch item is that Accenture controls the research framing and will recommend solutions that align with their payer technology practice. Have a differentiated point of view ready when payer clients ask.
so_what: Accenture's survey finding that only 46% of Gen Z and Millennial health plan members trust their payers is a market positioning move as much as a research finding. Accenture is using this data to anchor a payer transformation conversation. Know the methodology before your clients cite it.
original_title: Only 46% of Gen Z, Millennial health plan members trust payers: Accenture survey
